rpc_modules.meaning: RPC service and namespace discovery only; namespace presence does not promise individual method support.

arb_checkPublisherHealth.meaning: Successful publisher health check at observation time; no guarantee of future transaction acceptance or inclusion.

sendRawTransaction.proof: One empty byte string returned -32000: typed transaction too short, not method not found.

connectionReuse.evidence: Second sequential rpc_modules and arb_checkPublisherHealth requests each reported Node ClientRequest.reusedSocket=true through their respective https.Agent pools.
connectionReuse.limit: Only client-to-public-endpoint TCP/TLS reuse was observed. Backend routing, long idle survival and submission latency were not measured.

conclusions.healthHttpPath: No HTTP /health, /liveness or /readiness path was assumed or probed; the observed health method is JSON-RPC arb_checkPublisherHealth.

invalidPayloadSafety.reason: The empty byte sequence has no transaction type, fields, sender or signature. The Nitro go-ethereum handler decodes with Transaction.UnmarshalBinary before SubmitTransaction; decodeTyped rejects length <= 1 with typed transaction too short. The observed response matches that decoder rejection.

readRpc: latest block and timestamp for waiting
sequencer: eth_sendRawTransaction with locally validated canonical signed bytes for chain 4663
arb_checkPublisherHealth for bounded warm checks on the same persistent transport
recommendedRoles.warming: Reuse the same provider and HTTPS agent that will submit. Call arb_checkPublisherHealth before waiting and at a bounded interval while waiting. Treat JSON-RPC result:null without error as success. rpc_modules can test transport availability if health is unsupported, but does not replace publisher health. Stop background checks on cancellation and destroy the provider after use.
recommendedRoles.endpointBinding: Use the exact official HTTPS sequencer URL, validate TLS, reject redirects and credential-bearing URLs. Validate chain 4663 through an independent read RPC and locally in the signed transaction. Do not require eth_chainId from this send-only endpoint.
recommendedRoles.workflow: Read and preflight via RPC; submit factory deployment through sequencer; confirm receipt and deployed code via RPC; wait for observed chain time or block using RPC; submit mint through sequencer; verify receipt and NFT events via RPC.
recommendedRoles.uncertainSubmission: A transport timeout or lost response does not establish rejection. Preserve the raw transaction and local hash; query that hash on read RPC. Any retry must submit the identical bytes and nonce; do not replace it with a new deployment or mint nonce.
recommendedRoles.existingIntegrationNote: The pre-integration broadcaster probed eth_getTransactionByHash on the submitting provider after an uncertain result. The sequencer integration supplies separate lookupProviders for this read. Sequencer providers stay separate from read providers that require eth_chainId.
recommendedRoles.latency: Direct submission removes a configured application forwarding step, but this research does not establish that it is faster from this host. Health RPC timings are not submission or inclusion benchmarks.

primarySources.supports: Robinhood mainnet chain ID 4663 and separate official public RPC/sequencer endpoints; public endpoints are rate limited.
Robinhood uses first-come, first-served sequencing based on arrival time; paying higher fees does not bypass other transactions.

Arbitrum documents separate read/write RPC and sequencer submission endpoints, including sendRawTransaction and sendRawTransactionConditional. Queue defaults and timing on this page concern its documented Arbitrum endpoints, not a verified Robinhood configuration.
Nitro TxForwarder.CheckHealth calls arb_checkPublisherHealth on the upstream publisher; its client caches health for two seconds and bounds the health call timeout.
Normal forwarded transactions use the upstream Ethereum client SendTransaction; conditional options take a separate conditional path.
SendRawTransaction decodes the supplied bytes before SubmitTransaction.
The transaction decoder rejects zero-byte and one-byte typed envelopes.

limitations: No valid transaction or signed raw bytes were submitted; send handler reachability is confirmed, successful mainnet inclusion is not.
The exact deployed sequencer binary version, backend topology, configured queue size, rate limit and timeout are unknown.
No claim that Robinhood exposes every method in the arb or eth namespace; sendRawTransactionConditional was not probed.
The observed successful health and TCP reuse are point-in-time capabilities, not an uptime, idle lifetime or latency guarantee.
Earlier separate evidence research/simulate-capabilities.json records eth_simulateV1, eth_simulateV3 and web3_clientVersion as unavailable on this sequencer. They were not repeated here.
Only this research JSON file was changed for this task; no implementation changes are implied by recommendedRoles.
